QUOTE: "`DocsDbServer.staleness_notices()` (`server.py`) runs on the way out of every query reply and returns the `{axis, message}` list. `QueryTools._staleness()` attaches it to the payload" and "`staleness` is absent from the payload when nothing is stale."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the notice is attached to every query reply automatically and is absent/empty when the tool is current.
